title: First light
text: Coffee by the vehicle as the sun clears the mountains, then a slow morning scenic drive.

image.alt: Two guests with coffee beside a Land Rover at sunrise

title: Into the plains
text: Ride a fat e-bike across the gravel plains, or walk with a guide over ancient Bushman hunting grounds.

image.alt: A guest standing on the rocks above the plains in the early light

title: The quiet hours
text: Lunch on the breakfast deck, a book from the library, a swim, then a siesta in your sala.

image.alt: A guest resting on a shaded deck at golden hour

title: Sundowners
text: Climb to the rocky plateau above camp and watch the light drain from the desert.

title: Antares
text: Dinner by the open fire, then the naked-eye star safari under one of the darkest skies on earth.

image.alt: The Milky Way arching over a softly lit desert lodge at night
